items.reason: Verifier results write timestamped documents under the set’s verify directory.
Each completed verification writes once after fallback resolution; filename collisions retain earlier reports.
The contract keeps VERDICT first, and the remaining prose becomes the report body.
splitVerifierReply removes malformed lines such as “VERDICT: MAYBE” when prose follows, losing raw text from the report.
Report writing applies to PASS, FIXABLE, and NEEDS-HUMAN.
PASS findings must explain what was checked and why each criterion is met.
Cache hits return before report creation.
Invalidation still deletes cached verdicts without touching report files.
Previous reports are excluded from Verifier prompts; human-note forwarding remains unchanged.
Human acceptance writes a report without invoking an agent.
Human reports include the supplied rationale and overridden verdict.
Human reports explicitly identify human authorship and state that no Verifier ran.
Human reports use the same directory, timestamp machinery, common facts, and latest-report lookup.
The gate preamble renders the latest report’s path and commit metadata without its prose.
The paging action opens the report and returns to the gate menu.
The set detail view includes a Verify report pointer section.
Artifact ordering places Verify reports above Refine reports.
Agent prompt views gain no Verify pointer; only Verifier response-contract goldens change.
Missing Verify reports produce no preamble, paging entry, detail section, or artifact.
Verification status and verified-at badge logic remain independent of report age.
Status rows retain truncated findings but gain no report pointer; pointers are added only to detail and drain-summary surfaces.
Both passes share rendering, filing, timestamp scanning, header parsing, and pointer machinery.
Refine retains its directory, filename format, header structure, and existing surface presentation.
Refine prompt goldens are unmodified.

scores.rationale: Clear shared machinery and useful tests, but malformed-response preservation and status-row pointers remain incomplete and untested.
